steps.title: Set your station
steps.cue: Helmet on. Tee in front. Clear the hitting area.

steps.title: Make smooth contact
steps.cue: Send the ball toward the net with a controlled swing.

steps.title: Balance, then reset
steps.cue: Finish balanced. Reset before the next ball.

steps.title: Make room to swing
steps.cue: Helmet on. Adult to the side, clear of the bat.

steps.title: Toss, track, contact
steps.cue: An adult gently tosses a soft ball into the hitting area.

steps.title: Find your rhythm
steps.cue: Hit toward the net. Pause before the next toss.

steps.title: Get ready and low
steps.cue: Bend your knees. Show an open glove out front.

steps.title: Meet the gentle roll
steps.cue: Watch the ball into your glove on a level surface.

steps.title: Secure, then reset
steps.cue: Bring the ball in. Set your feet before a return throw.

steps.title: Show a ready glove
steps.cue: Use a soft ball and a comfortable distance.

steps.title: Watch it all the way
steps.cue: Receive a gentle, easy-to-reach throw in your glove.

steps.title: Secure the catch
steps.cue: Use your free hand to secure the ball, then reset.

steps.title: Pick a big target
steps.cue: Warm up first. Choose a comfortable distance.

steps.title: Step toward your target
steps.cue: Use an easy throw. Accuracy matters more than power.

steps.title: Reset between throws
steps.cue: Count your hits. Rest as needed and follow coach limits.

steps.title: Walk the line first
steps.cue: Set four cones on flat ground with room to move.

steps.title: Shuffle with control
steps.cue: Stay low. Use small side steps without crossing feet.

steps.title: Stay balanced
steps.cue: Pause at the end. Return, then rest between rounds.
